title: Nostalgic Japanese Tofu Agedashi
description: A citrusy and flaky Japanese dish featuring creme fraiche, this diabetic-friendly recipe is a nostalgic treat. It is made by boiling and then frying tofu in a light batter.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour and cornstarch.
Slowly add creme fraiche to the bowl and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Add grated daikon and ginger to the batter and mix well.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and gently add the tofu cubes.
Boil the tofu for 5 minutes, then remove it from the water with a slotted spoon.
Dip each tofu cube into the batter, coating it evenly.
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat and fry the battered tofu until golden brown.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and rice vinegar.
Serve the fried tofu with the soy sauce mixture drizzled on top.
